name: ns_proofsearch_resupply_pincer
rubric_version_reason: Narrow theorem-attempt substrate for the post-fractional pressure-dwell pincer after the static metric-kernel bridge was falsified. v0.2 enables qualitative cold-shot and post-run synthesis after the 2026-05-03 run showed the proof object can pivot sharply across iterations.
description: Bounded ZTARE theorem attempt for a SupplyLoad upper bound, ratchet lower-bound obstruction theorem, or proof-cost no-go/reranking theorem.

cage_meta.class_reason: Qualitative theorem-attempt substrate over the NS resupply-escape pincer eigenquestion.

disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rivals are adjudicated by theorem burden, counterexample quality, and reranking, not formula gaps.
enable_fit_primitive_reason: Qualitative theorem-search substrate; do not route as numerical fit primitive.
persona: You are a ruthless PDE theorem-search referee in Newton mode. The static fractional bridge is dead. Do not be timid: attempt the theorem. The task is not to solve all of Navier-Stokes, but it is to formalize or falsify the corrected pressure-dwell pincer and its new dynamic-realization node. A prior run found that SupplyLoad(E,k)=rho_resupply(E,k)*S(E,k)*sqrt(B(E,k)) against signed escape and viscous erasure is only kinematic unless explicit approximate packet fields U_n satisfy a residual-defect transfer certificate Defect_n<1. Reward theorem packets that either construct/exclude residual-stable supercritical packet fields, prove a PDE exclusion theorem, or sharpen the no-go/reranking theorem. Penalize metric-kernel substitution, pointwise P_inst chasing, generic 2D rhetoric, resupply-rate claims that ignore S*sqrt(B), envelope-only ratchet claims that ignore residual stability, and regularity/blowup overclaims.

dimensions.name: Supply-Load Eigenquestion Discipline
dimensions.description: Does the submission attack SupplyLoad=rho_resupply*S*sqrt(B), not the already-falsified pointwise pressure or metric-kernel bridge?

dimensions.name: Signed-Escape And Dwell Coupling
dimensions.description: Does it use section width W and escape-speed lower bound V to control T_section non-circularly?

dimensions.name: Viscous Packet Scaling
dimensions.description: Does it correctly use P_inst~S*sqrt(B*k), tau_visc~1/(nu*k^2), and one-packet impulse ~S*sqrt(B)/(nu*k^(3/2))?

dimensions.name: Resupply Bound Or Ratchet Obstruction Quality
dimensions.description: Does it provide a formal theorem attempt for a SupplyLoad upper bound, or an admissible ratchet obstruction theorem beating the k^(3/2) threshold without hiding dynamic-realization obligations?

dimensions.name: Residual-Defect Dynamic Realization
dimensions.description: Does it attack the iter-3 weakest node: explicit approximate packet fields U_n, projected NSE residual R_n, strain budget A_n, observable margin/Lipschitz control, and Defect_n<1 or a theorem excluding such certificates?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does it produce a concrete theorem packet for this exact pincer: hypotheses, conclusion, proof skeleton, formalizable SupplyLoad lemma, named ratchet obstruction family, or no-go/reranking theorem that changes the next NS build?

dimensions.name: Cycle And Return-Time Connection
dimensions.description: Does it explain how the result enters Q_dwell or cycle margin without back-solving from observed G and L, and does it name return-time requirements on the ratchet side?

dimensions.name: Claim Discipline
dimensions.description: Does it avoid claiming NS regularity/blowup and avoid hiding residual PDE burdens?

criteria.Supply_Load_Eigenquestion_Discipline: Full credit requires explicitly targeting rho_resupply*S*sqrt(B), not static metric degeneracy or pointwise P_inst alone.
criteria.Signed_Escape_And_Dwell_Coupling: Full credit requires non-circular W and V definitions and the dwell relation T_section<=W/V.
criteria.Viscous_Packet_Scaling: Full credit requires the k^(3/2) impulse threshold and correct treatment of tau_visc.
criteria.Resupply_Bound_Or_Ratchet_Obstruction_Qu: Full credit requires either a formal upper-bound theorem attempt or an admissible returning lower-bound obstruction theorem, while explicitly separating kinematic envelope claims from dynamic NSE realization.
criteria.Residual_Defect_Dynamic_Realization: Full credit requires a theorem packet centered on explicit U_n, projected residual R_n, strain budget A_n, observable Lip/Margin, and Defect_n<1; or a PDE exclusion/no-go theorem proving why such residual-stable packet certificates cannot exist.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires a concrete theorem packet: formalize a SupplyLoad lemma, formalize a ratchet obstruction, or prove/rerank to a cheaper discriminator.
criteria.Cycle_And_Return_Time_Connection: Full credit requires a non-circular connection to Q_dwell/cycle margin and explicit return-time obligations.
criteria.Claim_Discipline: Reject regularity/blowup overclaims, metric-kernel substitution, pointwise-only pressure arguments, and hidden recurrence burdens.
